'''Sparsh Hospital''' is an Indian multi-specialty [[Hospital network|hospital chain]] headquartered in [[Bengaluru, Karnataka|Bengaluru]], [[Karnataka]], India. It was founded in 2006 by [[orthopedic surgery|orthopedic surgeon]] Dr. Sharan Shivaraj Patil, and operates a network of hospitals in [[Bengaluru]] and other parts of [[Karnataka]].

== History ==
Sparsh Hospital was founded in 2006 by Dr. Sharan Shivaraj Patil as an orthopedic hospital in Health City, Bengaluru.<ref name=":1">{{cite web |title=Dr. Sharan Patil's Hope, Faith And Love |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/zen-garden/dr-sharan-patils-hope-faith-and-love/30872/1 |website=[[Forbes India]] |date=3 December 2011 |access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=From despair to hope |url=https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/health/medicine-and-research/From-despair-to-hope/article16886000.ece |website=[[The Hindu]] |date=11 October 2009|access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref> In 2007, the hospital received international media attention following the surgery of [[Lakshmi Tatma]], a child born with multiple extra limbs due to a rare congenital condition.<ref>{{cite web |title=8-limbed 'goddess' baby becoming normal little girl |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2008/HEALTH/conditions/06/19/eight.limbed.girl/ |website=[[CNN]] |date=19 June 2008|access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Indian doctors separate girl with many limbs from conjoined twin |url=https://www.smh.com.au/world/indian-doctors-separate-girl-with-many-limbs-from-conjoined-twin-20071107-18o2.html |website=[[The Sydney Morning Herald]] |date=7 November 2007 |access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Surgery going well for girl in India with 4 arms, 4 legs, doctors say |url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/surgery-going-well-for-girl-in-india-with-4-arms-4-legs-doctors-say-1.631130 |website=[[CBC News]] |date=6 November 2007 |access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Surgery on eight-limbed girl a success, doctors say |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2007/nov/07/india |website=[[The Guardian]] |date=7 November 2007 |access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref>

In 2015, Sparsh started a multispeciality hospital in [[Yeshwanthpur]], Bengaluru.<ref>{{cite web |title=Shiva & Shiva Orthopaedic Hospital Private Limited: Rating Rationale |url=https://www.icra.in/Rating/ShowRationalReportFilePdf/34904 |website=[[ICRA Limited|ICRA]] |publisher=Investment Information and Credit Rating Agency of India Limited |date=17 April 2017 |access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref> In 2018, the hospital group acquired a hospital in [[Hassan, Karnataka]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Sparsh Hospitals eyes Tier-2 cities for expansion |url=https://www.deccanherald.com/business/sparsh-hospitals-eyes-tier-2-692164.html |work=[[Deccan Herald]] |date=11 September 2018|access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Sparsh Group of Hospitals to create 1600 jobs over two years |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/healthcare/sparsh-group-of-hospitals-to-create-1600-jobs-over-two-years/articleshow/103907501.cms |work=[[The Economic Times]]|date=24 September 2023|access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref>

In 2022, [[Narayana Health|Narayana Hrudayalaya Limited]] acquired Sparsh's orthopedic hospital in Health City, Bengaluru, for approximately ₹200 crore.<ref>{{cite news |title=Narayana Hrudayalaya to acquire Bengaluru orthopaedic hospital for Rs 200 crore |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/narayana-hrudayalaya-to-acquire-bengaluru-orthopaedic-hospital-for-rs-200-crore-14655281.htm |work=[[CNBC]]|date=5 September 2022|access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Sparsh Hospitals Group opens three new specialties in Bengaluru |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/healthcare/sparsh-hospitals-group-opens-three-new-specialities-in-bengaluru/articleshow/99967212.cms |work=[[The Economic Times]]|date=4 May 2023|access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref>

In 2024, Sparsh started a 250-bed facility in [[Yelahanka]], Bengaluru.<ref>{{cite news |title=Sparsh Group of Hospitals opens 250-bed facility in Yelahanka in Bengaluru |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/sparsh-group-of-hospitals-opens-250-bed-facility-in-yelahanka-in-bengaluru/article68172368.ece |work=[[The Hindu]] |date=14 May 2024|access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref> In 2025, the group opened two new hospitals in Bengaluru: a 300-bed hospital in [[HBR Layout metro station|Hennur Road]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Sparsh Group to enter cancer care with a new 300-bed hospital |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/sparsh-group-to-enter-cancer-care-with-a-new-300-bed-hospital/article67007747.ece |website=[[Business Line]] |publisher=The Hindu Group |date=26 June 2023 |access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Health Minister Dinesh Gundu Rao opens Sparsh Group's 300-bed quaternary hospital in Bengaluru |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/bengaluru/2025/May/19/health-minister-dinesh-gundu-rao-opens-sparsh-groups-300-bed-quaternary-hospital-in-bengaluru |access-date=19 May 2026 |work=[[The New Indian Express]] |date=19 May 2025 |language=en}}</ref> and a 250-bed facility in [[Sarjapur|Sarjapur Road]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Sparsh Hospitals to come up in Hennur, Sarjapur |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/karnataka/2025/Feb/28/sparsh-hospitals-to-come-up-in-hennur-sarjapur |work=[[The New Indian Express]] |date=28 February 2025|access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=SPARSH opens new 250-bed hospital in Bengalaru, India |url=https://www.itij.com/latest/news/sparsh-opens-new-250-bed-hospital-bengalaru-india |access-date=19 May 2026 |work=[[International Travel & Health Insurance Journal]] |date=18 September 2025 |language=en}}</ref>

== Financials ==

According to credit rating reports, the group's operating entity, Shiva & Shiva Orthopaedic Hospital Private Limited, which manages the group's seven multi-specialty hospitals, had an operating income of ₹557.82 crore in financial year 2024-25. The company is fully owned by Dr. Sharan Shivaraj Patil and his wife Meena Patil.<ref>{{cite web |title=Shiva & Shiva Orthopaedic Hospital Private Limited |url=https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202604120423_Shiva_&_Shiva_Orthopaedic_Hospital_Private_limited.pdf |publisher=[[CARE Ratings]] |date=12 April 2026|access-date=19 May 2026}}</ref><ref name=":1"/>
